image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a weasel's head and upper neck in profile, facing right. The animal has golden-brown fur on its dorsal side and lighter cream/white fur on its ventral side (throat/chest). It features a pointed snout, small dark eye, short rounded ear, and visible whiskers. The background is a soft-focus bokeh of grey rock and dark shadows.

The visible eye is small, round, and black/dark brown, consistent with the species.
The ear is visible, short, and has a rounded tip, blending slightly into the head fur as expected.
